lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You need to analyze the quality of n metals, where t is the minimum purity, p, required to have it pass the quality test. Output keep for a metal that passes the test, or discard for one that doesn't. At the end, output the indexes of the selected metals, all separated by spaces, ranging from 0 to n - 1.
Input
Line 1: An integer t, representing the threshold required to have a metal pass quality test.
Line 2: An integer n representing the amount of metals to be analyzed.
Next n lines: An integer p, representing the purity of one metal for each line.
Output
n lines: keep or discard, depending on whether the metal passes the quality test.
Next line: The indexes of the selected metals, separated by spaces.
Constraints
0 <= t <= 1000
0 <= p <= 1000
0 < n < 9999
Example
Input
100
1
200
Output
keep
0
